topic: Sale price of a board game at half off
core_question: A $26 board game is 50% off. What is the sale price? (secondary: A bottle contains 3 liters of water. How many milliliters is that?)
answer_summary: the sale price of $13 (50% off a $26 board game); after the topic shift: the volume of 3,000 milliliters (3 liters converted to milliliters)
persona: sarcastic; texting quickly with typos here and there
